grades.quote: When the page size of the page table entry being filled is equal to the page size configured for STLB ( `CSR.STLBPS` ) it will be filled to STLB, otherwise it will be filled to MTLB.
grades.reason: Directly explains page-size-based TLB placement and identifies the configured size used for selection.

grades.quote: (A page directory entry can also directly point to a large page frame this size, just as without PAE it can directly point to a 4-MiB page frame.)
grades.reason: Explains that directory entries can directly represent large mappings, but does not explain page-size selection.

grades.quote: **P** age **S** ize ( `PS` ), `6` bits. `PS` appears only in the MTLB. It is used to specify the size of the pages stored in this page table entry. The value is a power of `2` of the page size. That is, for a page size of `16KB` , `PS=14` .
grades.reason: Directly describes per-entry page-size encoding and separately explains STLB size configuration.

grades.quote: For example, if different TLB entries can provide mappings for pages of varying sizes, the operating system will be able to map large, contiguously allocated structures with fewer TLB entries, while still retaining flexible allocation for the rest of virtual memory.
grades.reason: Provides background on the benefits of larger mappings, not their architectural encoding or page-size selection.
